payload.text: **The shell implementation is pruned at the cut, and nothing in the repo EXECUTES or EMITS a `bin/` intent script path.** **RESCOPED 2026-08-15 (vc) on dc's measurement -- the original wording, _"nothing in the repo references `bin/` intent scripts"_, IS UNSATISFIABLE HONESTLY and a sweeper obeying it would destroy the record.** Measured: **337 tracked files reference `bin/intent*`, and 133 are records of the PAST** -- `intent/history/`, `intent/st/COMPLETED/`, whiteboard `.history/`, CHANGELOG, `done.md`. **A completed thread saying "we changed `bin/intent_helpers`" is a true statement about 2026, and rewriting it to make a criterion go green falsifies the record.** The remaining 167 are four different things and only one is a defect: **(1) provenance citations in comments** -- the overwhelming majority, `render.rs` / `views.rs` / `facade.rs` / `contract.rs` each naming the v2 line a behaviour was ported from; **a citation to a deleted file is still a true citation, and deleting them destroys the only means anyone has of re-deriving the parity decisions**. **(2) executable dependencies** -- the real prune target, and it is SMALL and CONCENTRATED: `intent/plugins/claude/bin/*` sourcing `bin/intent_helpers` plus `plugins/claude/lib`, **all of which is WP-07's, so this half may be discharged by WP-07 landing rather than by a WP-12 sweep**. --- **CLASS (2) IS A PRUNE, NOT A PORT -- RULED BY vc 2026-08-30 ON dc's MEASUREMENT PLUS TWO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATIONS, AND THE ROW IS THE DOCUMENT THAT WAS WRONG.** `intent/plugins/claude/bin/` holds SEVEN scripts and the v3 binary has exactly TWO exec sites -- `render.rs:5958` (cwi) and `:6589` (template hook bodies). **Nothing in v3 can reach `intent_claude_{hook,prime,rules,skills,subagents,upgrade}`:** `skills` and `rules` answer rc=0 as RUST REIMPLEMENTATIONS, `subagents` and `prime` are rc=2 unwired with no shell-out path, and `claude hook` execs a TEMPLATE rather than `intent_claude_hook`. Their only executor is `bin/intent`, which the cut removes. **AND THE TREE HAD ALREADY DECIDED THIS IN THE ONE PLACE THAT SHIPPED, FOUR DAYS BEFORE ANYONE MEASURED IT:** `bin/.devbin/cmd/macos:160` sets `SUPPORT_PATHS` to `intent/plugins/claude/bin/intent_claude_cwi` -- **a FILE, not the directory** -- with a comment carrying hv's ruling that cwi is the ONE plugin script surviving the cut, and `intentsvcs/src/install.rs:361` resolves that one path and no other. **TWO DOCUMENTS DISAGREED AND ONLY ONE OF THEM HAD SHIPPED.** A criterion is a claim about what we intend; a packaging list is a claim that has been EXECUTED, and this one carries a ruling rather than a reading -- so pruning the six IMPLEMENTS an existing hv decision rather than making a new one. Fail-forward is the tiebreak and it is Intent's own rule: migrations actively prune, and scripts whose only executor is being deleted are exactly the residue it refuses. **THE PRUNE IS AUTHORISED FOR THE SIX UNEXECUTED SCRIPTS ONLY; any wider set is named with the same two-route evidence before it goes.** **AND THE ROW'S SCOPE SENTENCE WAS TOO NARROW IN TWO WAYS dc CORRECTED:** the source edge is not confined to `intent/plugins/claude/bin/*` -- `lib/rules_lib.sh:30` sources `bin/intent_helpers` too -- and the invisible edge is FOUR symbols, not one: `claude_plugin_helpers.sh` calls `calculate_checksum`, `ext_root_dir`, `require_claude` and `require_jq`, sourcing none. **AMENDED 2026-08-27 (dc, on vc's ruling) BECAUSE THE SPELLING ABOVE COULD BE DISCHARGED GREEN WHILE ITS SUBJECT STAYED BROKEN, AND A CRITERION THAT CAN BE SATISFIED WHILE ITS SUBJECT IS BROKEN IS WORSE THAN A MISSING ONE BECAUSE IT IS BELIEVED. A DEPENDENCY DOES NOT HAVE TO BE A `source` LINE.** `intent/plugins/claude/lib/claude_plugin_helpers.sh:84` CALLS `ext_root_dir()`, which is defined ONLY at `bin/intent_helpers:367`, and **never sources it** -- it rides on its two live sourcers (`intent_claude_skills`, `intent_claude_subagents`) having sourced the v2 helpers first. **That file is neither in `bin/*` nor a sourcer, so it sits outside the wording above, and porting all seven plugin bin files would close class (2) as originally specified while leaving `ext_root_dir()` dangling.** **SO CLASS (2) IS TWO EDGES, NOT ONE: a file that SOURCES `bin/intent_helpers`, and a file that CALLS a symbol `bin/` alone defines. The second is invisible to every sweep spelled `source`, and this criterion is not discharged until both are.** **DRIVEN TWO-SIDED RATHER THAN ASSERTED:** with the helpers in scope `plugin_root_tag` returns `ext:demoext` at rc=0, so the code path and the harness are both awake; with the helpers absent it returns **`unknown` at rc=0**, the `ext_root_dir: command not found` going to STDERR only -- **so under `2>/dev/null` there is no observable signal at all**, and every ext-installed plugin tags `unknown` after the cut with nothing reporting it. **AND THE SILENCE IS SUPPLIED BY A GUARD, WHICH IS THE PART THAT TRANSFERS BEYOND THIS BUG: `plugin_root_tag:85` short-circuits an empty `ext_base` to `unknown` DELIBERATELY** -- its own comment says an empty value would collapse the `case` pattern to `/*` and swallow every absolute path -- **so a defensive branch written to stop one failure is exactly what converts a missing dependency into a plausible wrong answer at success status.** `IN-AG-NO-SILENT-001`, with the silence written in on purpose for a different reason. **SCOPE RE-MEASURED WHILE HERE, CORRECTING A NARROWER READING: all SEVEN files under `intent/plugins/claude/bin/` source `bin/intent_helpers`, in three spellings** -- `$INTENT_ROOT/bin/` twice, `$INTENT_HOME/bin/` once, and a two-step `INTENT_BIN=` four times -- **so a grep for the literal `INTENT_ROOT/bin/` returns TWO and reads as a complete answer to a narrower question than the one asked.** The surface those seven take is nine functions (`error`, `warning`, `require_jq`, `require_claude`, `calculate_checksum`, `calculate_dir_checksum`, `detect_project_version`, `read_config_field`, `version_gt`), and `cwi` alone needs `error`. **`intent/plugins/claude/lib/` SURVIVES the cut and `claude_plugin_helpers.sh` is already the family's own home, so all seven cost barely more than one -- the hard part, choosing the home, is already decided. NOT STARTED AND DELIBERATELY SO: hv's expunge ruling scopes the prune, and building the lib move first would commit the seam before the thing it serves is scoped (vc, 2026-08-27).** **(3) parity fixtures** (`intent/st/ST0056/parity/**`, 42 files) -- reference data describing v2 behaviour, and **if they are the migration's evidence they must outlive the thing they describe**; a WP-12 call, not a sweep target. **(4) emitted strings** -- the genuine defect class, since a v2 path in a remedy names a file the user cannot possibly have. **(4) IS EMPTY, measured**: the sole candidate, `transitions.rs:264`'s `note:` carrying `bin/intent_acceptance:987`, sits on the `Unbuilt` enum variant with ZERO read sites -- the same shape as AC-00.9's own `Entry.v2` correction, and it looked like a second instance of that defect in the very file AC-00.9 named. **Nothing in the v3 binary emits a v2 script path.** **Classes (1) and the 133 historical records are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE of this criterion** and are named here so that nobody satisfying it deletes them. **Already discharged by construction**: `close_gate_parity.rs:505,575,655` probe for `bin/intent` and skip the live differential when it is absent (_"post-cutover tree?"_), so those three survive the prune without a WP-12 edit **EXCEPTION RULED BY hv 2026-08-25 21:3xZ, FIRST-HAND IN vc's SESSION, AND IT IS DATED RATHER THAN OPEN-ENDED: THE `claude ws` FAMILY SURVIVES THE CUT.** hv chose _spare ws, with a dated expiry_ over _WP-14 before WP-12_ and over _ship without a provisioner_. **GROUND: `AC-12.1` prunes `bin/` while the whiteboard PROVISIONER is contracted in WP-14 (`AC-14.10`), Not Started -- so at the cut it does not degrade, it DISAPPEARS**, and the obvious fix is wrong because `AC-14.7` serves every `/in-whiteboard` verb FROM THE STORE, making a port of the file-based implementation a build of the very thing WP-14 exists to replace. **SCOPE OF THE EXCEPTION, MEASURED NOT ASSERTED: the family is `cmd_ws_new` / `cmd_ws_list` / `cmd_ws_archive` / `cmd_ws_hygiene` in `intent/plugins/claude/bin/intent_claude_cwi`, and its ENTIRE `bin/` dependency is ONE LINE -- `:31 source "$INTENT_ROOT/bin/intent_helpers"`.** **NOTE THAT THIS SITS INSIDE CLASS (2) ABOVE, WHICH ALREADY ROUTES `intent/plugins/claude/bin/*` TO WP-07 RATHER THAN TO A WP-12 SWEEP -- so the exception has TWO discharge routes and only one of them is WP-14:** WP-07 porting `cwi` off `intent_helpers` retires the exception without anyone deleting a verb, and WP-14 retires it by replacing the verbs with `intent wb`. **WP-07 IS WIP AND CLAIMED (dc); WP-14 IS NOT STARTED AND UNCLAIMED.** **THE EXPIRY IS STRUCTURAL, NOT REMEMBERED: `AC-14.12` BELOW IS A CLOSING CONDITION OF WP-14, SO THE EXCEPTION CANNOT OUTLIVE THE WORK PACKAGE THAT RETIRES IT.** That is deliberate and it is the whole reason hv's option was worded with an expiry: a workaround outlives its bug BECAUSE A DEFECT ANNOUNCES ITSELF AND A DEFECT'S DISAPPEARANCE DOES NOT, so an exception whose end is a note somebody remembers is an exception with no end.
